name: Oakley
verdict: Oakley is a subsidiary of Luxottica Group; its parent EssilorLuxottica SA is listed on Euronext Paris and its largest shareholder is Delfin S.à r.l. at 32.42%. Nothing found.
note: Official Supplier of the Switzerland SailGP team (sailgp.com team page). Sport performance brand; EssilorLuxottica SA is the group's parent (see the reused essilorluxottica-record claim); no state or state-fund holder found in this run.
